advisories.title: Monsoon Season: Dengue & Malaria Prevention
advisories.description: During the monsoon season (June-September), dengue and malaria cases increase in Hyderabad. Protect yourself with mosquito repellent, wear full-sleeve clothing, and ensure your surroundings are free of stagnant water.
tips: Use mosquito repellent creams or sprays regularly
Wear full-sleeve shirts and long pants during dawn and dusk
Remove stagnant water from containers, coolers, and flower pots
Sleep under mosquito nets
Seek immediate medical attention if you develop fever, headache, or body aches

advisories.title: Waterborne Diseases During Monsoon
advisories.description: Monsoon brings increased risk of waterborne diseases like cholera, typhoid, and gastroenteritis. Ensure water safety and maintain proper hygiene.
tips: Drink only boiled or filtered water
Wash hands frequently with soap and water
Avoid street food and ensure food is cooked properly
Maintain personal hygiene and clean surroundings
Get vaccinated against typhoid and cholera if recommended

advisories.title: Summer: Heat Stroke & Dehydration Prevention
advisories.description: Hyderabad summers (March-May) are extremely hot. Protect yourself from heat stroke and dehydration by staying hydrated and avoiding prolonged sun exposure.
tips: Drink plenty of water throughout the day
Avoid going out during peak sun hours (11 AM - 4 PM)
Wear light-colored, breathable clothing
Use sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher
Eat water-rich fruits like watermelon, cucumber, and oranges
Watch for signs of heat stroke: dizziness, nausea, rapid heartbeat

advisories.title: Summer Skin Care Tips
advisories.description: Protect your skin during summer from sun damage, prickly heat, and fungal infections common in hot and humid weather.
tips: Take cool baths or showers to reduce body temperature
Use talcum powder or anti-fungal powder to prevent prickly heat
Keep skin dry, especially in folds
Wear breathable cotton clothing
Avoid harsh soaps; use mild cleansers
Apply moisturizer to prevent dry skin

advisories.title: Winter: Flu & Cold Prevention
advisories.description: Winter months (November-February) see increased cases of flu and common cold in Hyderabad. Strengthen immunity and practice preventive measures.
tips: Get vaccinated against influenza
Wash hands frequently to prevent virus transmission
Avoid touching your face, eyes, and mouth
Maintain distance from people with cold or flu symptoms
Stay warm and avoid sudden temperature changes
Get adequate sleep to boost immunity

advisories.title: Winter Respiratory Health
advisories.description: Winter can exacerbate respiratory conditions like asthma and bronchitis. Take precautions to protect your lungs.
tips: Avoid cold air exposure; wear a mask if needed
Use a humidifier to keep air moist
Avoid smoke and air pollution
Stay hydrated with warm fluids
Do light exercises like walking to improve lung capacity
Keep inhalers and medications accessible if you have asthma

advisories.title: General Hygiene & Wellness
advisories.description: Maintain good hygiene practices year-round to prevent common illnesses and infections.
tips: Wash hands before eating and after using the toilet
Keep your living space clean and well-ventilated
Maintain a balanced diet with fruits and vegetables
Exercise regularly for at least 30 minutes daily
Get 7-8 hours of quality sleep
Manage stress through meditation or yoga

advisories.title: Vaccination Reminder
advisories.description: Stay up-to-date with recommended vaccinations to protect yourself and your community from preventable diseases.
tips: Check your vaccination status with your doctor
Get vaccinated against COVID-19 if not already done
Ensure childhood vaccinations are complete
Get annual flu shots during flu season
Consider typhoid and hepatitis A vaccines if traveling
Consult your doctor about other recommended vaccines
